answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. By tethering identity to economic value, the system creates a reef of financial barriers that block malicious clones. At the zenith of network security, every validated pulse of data requires a proportionate asset lock, forcing an attacker to sustain prohibitive costs to acquire enough stake for a majority takeover, effectively neutralizing the efficacy of unauthorized, low-cost identities.
